whatsappMessage:
Hi Team R.R.Restaurant and cafe,

I noticed your cafe has stellar 4.8★ reviews near A.N. College on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online food orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur popular dishes showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/r-r-restaurant-and-cafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team R.R.Restaurant and cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If yes]: Great! We tailored it specifically with online table reservations, WhatsApp menu ordering, and showcasing your top-rated dishes right on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If no]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur real photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
